$comment: C76.1: the watchlist sources the operator's sync reads (pnpm --filter @openverify/api watchlists:sync, pep:sync, or the watchlists-refresh tick with OPENVERIFY_WATCHLIST_REFRESH=true). Live list data is never committed or shipped (ADR 0005): this file says where the sync fetches each list, which one host a redirect may go to, the content types and byte caps, the deadline, the parser, the refresh and staleness intervals (provisional, from the research's cadence notes), the setting a source needs, its terms note and its attribution line. OFSI's Consolidated List closed on 2026-01-28 and is never a source. No publisher change signal is read: every check downloads the file and compares its SHA-256 (owner decision 10 after Workflow 6B). Sizes measured on 2026-10-22 are in docs/research/phase6-data-sources.md.
